description: Every Monday at 7:00 (Sydney time) counts the content pieces planned for next week and, if there are fewer than Posts per week (set in the agent's Preferences), creates the missing social posts on free weekdays, each built around one of the Brand Kit's key messages. Each new piece is drafted and reviewed as usual. Off when Posts per week is empty or 0. Running it again in the same week adds nothing. Uses no AI itself and posts nothing.
